scientific_findings.mesh_and_uel_qualification: The 15,252-quad C6 mesh (15,559 nodes, 59 duplicate slit pairs, kinematic ties, and 30,504 dual user elements: 15,252 phase U1 + 15,252 mechanical U2) with frozen production UEL compiled cleanly with ifort 2021.13.0, linked with GNU ld, and executed to completion in 1.2s CPU time with 0 errors on compute node mnode097, confirming full structural and numerical validity of the non-coarsened C6 deck.
scientific_findings.stage_c3_0_re_equilibration_requirement: The single-step direct input deck solved pure linear-elastic deformation from zero state (E_elastic = 0.274e-3 kN mm, E_fracture = 0.0 kN mm) without invoking the staggered PDAS driver or applying transferred damage d and history H. Therefore, authentic coupled re-equilibration acceptance (Delta d < 1e-6, KKT satisfied) strictly requires staging a coupled PDAS driver package (Package 171) mirroring the validated Package 166-R3 architecture.
